topics.label: Land Use & Permissible Uses
topics.description: Main and ancillary land uses permitted or prohibited in Residential, Commercial, Industrial, Public/Semi-Public, Traffic & Transportation, and Green zones across Rings I, II, and III.

topics.label: Floor Area Ratio (FAR), Premium FAR & TDR
topics.description: Permissible Floor Area Ratio (FAR), exclusions from FAR computation, Impact Zone / Metro Premium FAR, Premium FAR by road width, and Transfer of Development Rights (TDR / DRC).

topics.label: Ground Coverage
topics.description: Maximum permissible plot ground coverage percentage by zone, plot size, and building type.

topics.label: Setbacks & Building Lines
topics.description: Front, rear, left, and right minimum setbacks by plot size or building height, distance between buildings, and building lines along arterial roads.

topics.label: Building Height & High-Rise Norms
topics.description: Maximum permissible building height, high-rise building threshold (15 m and above), aviation/HAL/AAI NOC height limits, and number of floors.

topics.label: Parking & Ramps
topics.description: Minimum off-street car and two-wheeler parking requirements by building use, visitor parking, mechanical/multi-level parking, and ramp width/slope rules.

topics.label: Basements, Cellars & Stilt Floors
topics.description: Permissibility, number, setback, height, and permitted uses of basement/cellar floors and stilt parking floors.

topics.label: Projections, Balconies, Open Spaces & Buffers
topics.description: Chajjas, balconies, canopies, open staircases in setbacks, compound walls, courtyards, and lake/valley/storm-water-drain (nala) buffer zones.

topics.label: Plot Size, Frontage & Subdivision
topics.description: Minimum plot area and frontage for apartments, commercial uses, and subdivisions/development plans.

topics.label: Road Width & Means of Access
topics.description: Measurement of road width, minimum road width for apartments, high-rise buildings, and commercial uses, cul-de-sacs, and splay at road intersections.

topics.label: Deviations, Compounding & Penalties
topics.description: Condonable limits of construction deviation in setback, coverage, FAR, and height (Table-2B) and compounding fees (Table-2A, Table-2C, Table-2D).

topics.label: Plan Sanction, Plinth & Occupancy Certificates
topics.description: Building licence application, scrutiny fee, ground rent, commencement/plinth certificate, completion report, and Occupancy Certificate (OC).

topics.label: Fire Protection, Exit Requirements & Structural Safety
topics.description: Fire protection norms, Fire Force NOC for high-rise buildings, fire driveway, refuge area, staircases/exits, rainwater harvesting, and solar requirements.

topics.label: Definitions of Building & Planning Terms
topics.description: Statutory definitions of technical, architectural, and planning terms across the Building Bye-laws and Master Plan Zoning Regulations.

succession.old_body: Bangalore Mahanagara Palike / Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BMP / BBMP)
aliases: Corporation of the City of Bangalore
succession.new_body: Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) and the 5 City Corporations (Bengaluru Central, North, South, East, and West City Corporations)
succession.instrument_title: The Greater Bengaluru Governance Act, 2024 (Karnataka Act No. 36 of 2025), Preamble, Sections 4, 5, 360 & 361 (pp. 161, 167, 291–292)
succession.quoted_evidence: WHEREAS, the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike was established in 2008 and was governed under the provisions of the Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act, 1976 (Karnataka Act 14 of 1977) and later by the provisions of Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike Act, 2020 (Karnataka Act 53 of 2020). ... WHEREAS, it is expedient to establish the Greater Bengaluru Authority and introduce new provisions for governing the Corporations and Ward Committees in the Greater Bengaluru Area; ... 4. Civic Authorities in the Greater Bengaluru Area.- The following shall be the Civic Authorities in the Greater Bengaluru Area tasked with the powers to carry out the functions specified under this Act: (a) the Greater Bengaluru Authority; (b) the City Corporations; and (c) the Ward Committees. ... 360. Transitory Provisions.- Any rule, notification, order or appointment, made or issued under the Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act, 1976 (Karnataka Act No. 14 of 1977), the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike Act, 2020 (Karnataka Act No. 53 of 2020) and Rules made thereunder ... shall continue to be in force and effective as if they are made or issued or appointed under the corresponding provisions of this Act ... 361. Repeal and Savings.- (1) The provisions of the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike Act, 2020 (Karnataka Act No. 53 of 2020) and Rules made thereunder are hereby repealed.

succession.old_body: Commissioner, Bangalore Mahanagara Palike / Commissioner, BBMP
succession.new_body: Commissioner of the respective City Corporation (and Chief Commissioner, Greater Bengaluru Authority)
succession.instrument_title: The Greater Bengaluru Governance Act, 2024 (Karnataka Act No. 36 of 2025), Sections 2(11), 2(16), 10(3), 25 & 230(1) (pp. 163, 170, 177, 247)
succession.quoted_evidence: (11) “Chief Commissioner” means the Chief Commissioner of the Greater Bengaluru Authority appointed under section 10; ... (16) “Commissioner” means the Commissioner of a City Corporation appointed under this Act; ... 10. (3) The Chief Commissioner shall be the Principal Executive Officer of the Greater Bengaluru Authority ... 25. The Authorities of the City Corporation.- The following shall be the Authorities of the City Corporation who shall carry out the provisions of the Act, namely:- (a) The Mayor; (b) The Commissioner; (c) The Joint Commissioners; ... 230. Procedure for grant of sanction to building plan.– (1) Any person intending to construct or reconstruct a building, shall by way of an application, as specified in building bye-laws shall apply to the Commissioner for permission to execute the work.

succession.new_body: Greater Bengaluru Authority (Planning Authority for Greater Bengaluru Area) & Local Planning Area of Bengaluru (BDA)
succession.instrument_title: The Greater Bengaluru Governance Act, 2024 (Karnataka Act No. 36 of 2025), Section 14(2)(a)–(b) (p. 173) & Notification No. UDD 468 MNJ 2025(E) (15-10-2025)
succession.quoted_evidence: 14. (2) Planning Functions: Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force,- (a) the Greater Bengaluru Authority shall be the “Planning Authority” as defined under the Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961, for the areas comprising of the Greater Bengaluru Area; (b) within the physical boundaries of Greater Bengaluru area the approval of any layout including the industrial layout may be done by Greater Bengaluru Authority in conformity with the master plan and to ensure proper circulation of traffic, Plan Sanction of such industrial units shall be done by the respective City Corporation; | Notification No. UDD 468 MNJ 2025(E) (15-10-2025, p. 1): “These may be called the Zonal Regulations of Revised Master Plan-2015 of the Local Planning Area of Bengaluru (BDA) and Local Planning Area of Greater Bengaluru Authority (Amendment) Regulations 2025.”
